I replied to Marcus in your DM: he should keep **Tuesday 10 Nov at 10:15** free.

- **Where the time comes from:** On 14 Oct, Marcus messaged me that his standing call with the Tamsin Cold Chain team about the Driftwood rollout had moved to Tuesdays at 10:15. I found that message saved in the knowledge brain, and I haven't seen anything since that changes it.
- **Not on his calendar:** He has nothing on his calendar for 9–15 Nov. I suggested he add the call or confirm the time with the Tamsin team.

The only source was Marcus's own DM, so this stayed in his conversation and didn't go anywhere else.
